description: Land Acquisition - Palle Inguruwatta,  Mawathagama D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically declaring that certain described lands are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, boundaries, extents, and locations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters. While it mentions a government minister, the core content is about land acquisition rather than government personnel or structural changes.
